content: Me mapmedi tam tubune kap toiŋ
Mede momohi nadinadine gineŋ hakiiŋ. U kap foloŋ tubumintaaŋ me mapmedok youlimimbit. Mabelemne adi me kudi momohi youkiiŋ heki’walaŋ kundifiŋ (pen) nabugoŋ.
Du adi me momooŋ, nebek niŋ du indiniŋ nemoŋ. Mage foloŋ adi kulema mede hogok mintalak. Bepaŋdi kahaŋ momooŋ tigamgukdi tigamulak.
Du me mapme saŋiniŋgenit hinek. Eŋ tinahukutge adi beweniŋgoŋ hinek, tiŋa wohogegigitdi loloŋnit hatak. Ale miknoŋge tiŋa mik titiŋdok tiulidoko tibeŋ.
Du adi mapme uŋgoniŋ hinek, eŋ wohogegigitnit. Du helemahelemaŋ mede biyagoŋ eŋ titiŋ didimeniŋ yehi-ulihiluwaaŋ. Du adi mik fafaŋe tiŋa tubune me kadakahi adi dutok munta kisaŋ hinek tiiŋ.
Bohomge adi maŋiŋhinit wendi memik heki kisaŋ yedetomulak. Du me noli mik fafaŋe tiŋa widihiune adi wabiŋa du’walaŋ hebeke foloŋ hatiiŋ.
Bepaŋdi du mapme hatidok ganindapmaguk doktiŋa saŋiniŋge haliwooŋ halaak. Du metamgeye titiŋ didimeniŋ foloŋ hogok yabudokolaŋ.

Du adi titiŋ didimeniŋdok adi nadiune utumba tilak, eŋ titiŋ hogohidok adi nadikwihita tilaŋ. Unduŋ doktiŋa Bepaŋ, da’walaŋ Bepaŋgedi mapme wapum hatidok ganindapmaaŋ nadifo diniŋ wahu munduŋdi gedegomguk wendi mapme nokeye yedegomgiŋ u yalakapme tilak.
Dahidahige adi haguwo munduŋ momohi mel

, alo tiŋa kasiya’walaŋ munduŋhikdi hogok kutak. Me mapme’walaŋ yoli adi tehindilendilene uŋgoniŋ uŋgoniŋ kale (elefan) maŋiŋdi tutumbagiŋ wendi tinahukulimiŋgiŋ, tiŋa du nadifo titiŋdok baiwagim tokudikudile tigambune nadifo tilaŋ.
Kaŋ me mapme heki’walaŋ wabihiye adi tam wohiyenit gut du yokeneŋ hakiiŋ. Kaŋ tam wapme adi kohoge didimeniŋneŋkade yatak. Adi yadi kwet wapum Ofili uŋoŋ gol tutumbagiŋ u tinahukula yatak.
Tamkuya me mapme hemindok tilaŋ, du nu’walaŋ medene hogok baigoŋ nadihinakaweŋ. Du metamgeye tiŋa da’walaŋ magemageye hinek u kauleyem tibeŋ.
Mapme adi folonamandapge momooŋ doktiŋa gabuŋa nadigalika tibek. Adi yadi me wapumge, unduŋ doktiŋa adi’walaŋ medeŋiŋ tagimneluwaaŋ.
Taiyahi metam adi siloŋ moŋgokamuŋa buneeŋ. Kaŋ me bomboŋ mohokhinitdi menot tigamunene bomboŋ mowodi buneŋ.
Me mapme tamŋiŋ adi folonamandap momooŋ hogok, wendi ne’walaŋ yotmaaŋ gineŋ hatilak. Tiŋa tinahukutŋiŋ adi tawa golnit wendi tibinegiŋ u tinahukutak.
Dahidahiŋiŋ woŋ adi kudikudinit. Tamkuya u agaŋ nagila me mapme’walaŋ wiiŋ. Kaŋ tamkuya noliŋiye adi maaŋ keletawiiŋ.
Adi welemomooŋ nadiŋa nadifooŋ me mapme yoli wapumneŋ foiŋ.
Me mapme, du mihigeye fee mintaaŋ papageye diniŋ kayoŋkoŋ yabukahileneeŋ. Du saŋiniŋ yemiŋa yenindapmaune adi kwetkwet metam hogohogok yabudokoneeŋ.
Nu wohoge yohautawene metam hogohogok kougoŋ mintaŋ hatineeŋ adi helemahelemaŋ du nadigamuneeŋ. Kaŋ wendoktiŋa metam hogohogok adi du wohoge ganintiloneeŋ.
